# ShellManager

> **File:** `services/core/ShellManager.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

Shell manager manages global options and signals

### Properties

- `linkOrigin` (readonly string): The overlay page a link was last followed from (a view type, or ""): the navigator offers to go back to it until the user navigates themselves or the overlay closes (OverlayPages keeps it)
- `followingLink` (readonly bool): Whether the page switch under way is a link being followed
- `surfaceWindows` (var): `{ group, kind, window }`: each instance's window, which the one holding the focus grab lets input through to
- `openSurfaces` (var): SurfaceGroups open anywhere, `{ group, kind }`: whether a launcher, overlay or power menu is up (a hover-activated button won't close it)
- `borderOpenings` (var): `{ owner, screen, edge, start, end }` (a screen name, a Bar.edgeName, screen px along the edge): surfaces joined to the border's inner stroke, which leaves it open under them while surfaces are trans…
- `grabPartners` (var): Windows a full-screen surface's focus grab lets input through to on their screen: the bars and their popouts, so they stay usable while the overlay is open.
- `captureWindows` (var): The screenshot pickers while one is open: every focus grab lets input through to them, so taking a screenshot closes nothing
- `captureFrozen` (readonly bool): Every picker's frame is frozen: popup windows (bar popouts, tooltips, menus, toasts) hide until it closes, since Hyprland draws popups over every layer.
- `requiredFields` (readonly var): Which screen layout surfaces (the lock screen's, the greeter's, by the key their host gives their modules) show their required field: the Password module, the Login module.
- `modalWindows` (readonly var): Windows every focus grab lets input through to: the screenshot pickers and modal prompts (the polkit prompt, registerModal), so one opening over the overlay or a popout closes nothing
- `modalShown` (readonly bool): One of them is up: a focus grab's surface stops asking for the keyboard exclusively (FocusGrab.exclusive), which would keep it from the prompt
- `steppedAside` (readonly bool): Set while a prompt axiom doesn't draw needs the screen (another polkit agent's window, the file picker: windows open under axiom's Overlay-layer surfaces): the overlay and the onboarder hide without …
- `barPanels` (var): The bar windows (BarPanel), for surfaces that attach to a bar without being its popouts (floating edge menus)
- `destructiveActions` (readonly var): Session actions, shared by the power menu and the QuickActions module.

### Signals

- `openPowerMenu()`
- `toggleAppLauncher()`
- `toggleOverlay()`
- `toggleWorkspaceOverlay()`
- `showOverlayPage(string type)`: Switch the overlay to a page by view type or a view's name ("Themes" and "Layouts" for the pinned page), e.g. from a settings link
- `openOverlayPage(string type)`: Opens the target overlay on a page (a view type, or a view's name)
- `closeOverlay()`: Closes the overlay wherever it's open
- `showOsd(string id)`: Opens an OSD by id where it would open for a change (the settings page's Show button)
- `surfaceShown(string kind, bool shown)`: Surfaces on every monitor at once act as one: each SurfaceGroup reports its instance opening or closing, and the others follow

### Functions

- `followLink(type)`: Opens a page as a link from the current one (SettingsLink, a page button), so the navigator offers the way back
- `setLinkOrigin(type)`: Sets or ("") drops the way back (OverlayPages, as it switches pages)
- `followLinkBack()`: Back to the page the last link was followed from
- `openModule(types)`: Opens the overlay page with the biggest module of the first of `types` any page has, else an edge menu with one (the first of `types` again); false with none
- `modeFor(target)`: A surface's ScreenTarget mode with "inherit" resolved: "primary" | "focused" | "all" | "named" (no target is General's)
- `targetFor(target)`: The screen whose instance of a surface answers a shortcut or IPC call and holds the keyboard: the focused monitor when it opens there or everywhere, else the first it's built on
- `isTarget(screen, target)`
- `everywhere(target)`: Opens on every monitor at once (SurfaceGroup keeps the instances in step)
- `showsOn(screen, target)`: Whether a surface opened for its target also shows on `screen`
- `registerSurfaceWindow(group, kind, window)`
- `unregisterSurfaceWindow(group)`
- `setSurfaceOpen(group, kind, open)`
- `surfaceOpen(kind)`
- `surfaceOpenOn(kind, screen)`: Whether one is up on `screen` (a ShellScreen or its name)
- `setBorderOpening(owner, opening)`: `opening` is `{ screen, edge, start, end }`, or null to drop the owner's
- `registerGrabPartner(window, screenName)`
- `unregisterGrabPartner(window)`
- `grabPartnersFor(screen)`: Every screen's with no screen given
- `newSurfaceKey(kind)`
- `reportRequiredField(key, present)`
- `registerModal(window)`
- `unregisterModal(window)`
- `beginStepAside(owner)`
- `endStepAside(owner)`
- `registerBar(panel)`
- `unregisterBar(panel)`
- `barOn(screenName, location)`: The enabled bar on a screen edge (a Bar.Location), or null
- `sessionActionInfo(action)`: A session action's icon and label, the same everywhere it's offered
- `sessionAction(action)`
